atly_aggregator_notes: atly.com/location/ConfleiFoodTruck and category pages (best-food-trucks-hamburger Miami) describe it as a Venezuelan street food truck known for Maracaibo-style hamburgers, patacones and pepitos, family-friendly, 'hidden gem', consistently excellent service, reasonable prices for generous portions, sauce bottle provided on the side.

reviewSamples.text: Food was amazing! Service was amazing. Owner & family are very friendly made us feel so welcomed.

reviewSamples.author: Photo of Jessica Hayes
reviewSamples.text: Must eat!!! This food truck hit the spot on a Tuesday night when everything was closed I’m so glad we went. Family owned authentic Venezuelan food at an affordable price with the best top notch service. I highly recommend trying this food truck. Super clean, can’t wait to go back when we are in FL again.
